spec.command:
set -o pipefail
VOL='vol --offline -s /tmp/dfirswarm-batman-ii-preparation/home/packs/memory-forensics/vendor/symbols -f inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw'
mkdir -p "$OUT/proc"
$VOL -o "$OUT/proc" windows.memmap.Memmap --pid 3768 --dump > "$OUT/memmap.txt"
dump=$(find "$OUT/proc" -type f | head -1)
printf 'dump=%s\n' "$dump" > "$OUT/dump-info.txt"
strings -a -t d -n 4 "$dump" > "$OUT/proc-ascii.txt"
strings -a -e l -t d -n 3 "$dump" > "$OUT/proc-utf16.txt"
grep -Eai 'keepass|bruce\.kdbx|password|username|exodus|deleted|recycle|master|key|entry' "$OUT/proc-ascii.txt" > "$OUT/proc-ascii-hits.txt" || true
grep -Eai 'keepass|bruce\.kdbx|password|username|exodus|deleted|recycle|master|key|entry' "$OUT/proc-utf16.txt" > "$OUT/proc-utf16-hits.txt" || true
ls -lh "$OUT" "$OUT/proc"; wc -l "$OUT"/*.txt
